openings.claim: Challenge the supposed necessity of confusion tables: a supported rule decision implies a confusion table was built (B→M). Neither M→B nor its converse follows merely from the counting function.
openings.delta: Remove the confusion-table carrier. Use a record ledger of candidate-correct minus baseline-correct, summed overall and per slice, with uncertainty bounds for unresolved flagged labels and a linked adjudication log. This supplies a source-compatible counterexample to table necessity.
openings.prediction: Against the nearest rival, confusion tables using the same selected rows, supported decisions and affected slices coincide; the ledger produces them without confusion cells. Timing differences remain unknown.
openings.probe: Run both carriers on matched copies with identical deterministic selection of prediction-disagreeing flagged rows nearest decision boundaries. Preserve sixteen-access caps, log withheld attempts, and freeze reports before opening the supplied key. Compare decisions, accounting, time and constructed tables.
assumptions: Unresolved differing predictions receive conservative contribution bounds [-1,1]; matching predictions contribute zero regardless of label.
Advance requires worst-case bounds to satisfy both unchanged thresholds; otherwise adjudicate within allowance or report unresolved.

openings.claim: Challenge the supposed necessity of any adjudication for supported advance. Counterexample, not an observation: all flagged rows have matching classifier predictions, and fixed paired gains satisfy both thresholds.
openings.delta: Remove sealed-row access when a prediction-agreement audit proves all disputed labels irrelevant to paired improvement; retain the record and zero-access logs.
openings.prediction: In that conditional case, zero-access bounds and ordinary bounded adjudication both advance and match the key, including under four withheld rows.
openings.probe: Compare the agreement audit with ordinary adjudication on matched copies; freeze both reports, then inspect the key. If influential disputed rows exist, do not claim this counterexample occurred.
assumptions: Actual flagged prediction agreements and other slice deltas are unspecified.
Defeated if unresolved differing predictions leave any acceptance threshold unsettled; no supported advance then follows.

assessment: These are workflow probes, not deployment claims. R1 fails if its bounds or ledger disagree with correctly computed rival results. Sixteen accessible adjudications and seventy minutes may leave either report unresolved; a cap alone guarantees no informative result.
